text_block_list.text:
And then, there's that overwhelmingly 
fierce passion...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm gonna be in there with 
them! —Definitely!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Trainer, keep your eyes on me, okay?!

text_block_list.text:
Powering up both my diet and my training!! 
Just you wait, everyone~!

text_block_list.text:
Ohh! That's right, I've gotta overtake 
them!!

text_block_list.text:

Allllriiiiiiight!!

"In the next race... the one crossing the 
finish line in first place will be this 
Tsuyoshi~!!"
